# sidequest

> A personal log of things worth rescuing from being forgotten - tools, GitHub repos, articles,
> books, courses, communities, remote job boards, referral links, and notable tech companies -
> found incidentally while doing something else. Not a comprehensive directory of the best or
> most famous tools; deliberately excludes things a typical person in the field would already
> know about (LinkedIn, YouTube, Google, and the like).

sidequest is a static site generated from flat YAML files in a public git repository. There is no
database and no user accounts. Every entry is a single YAML file, so the underlying data is easy
to read, fork, and reuse.

## Data model

Two entity types, with separate schemas:

- **Links** (`data/links/<root>[/<sub>]/<slug>.yaml`) - any saved resource, filed under one of
  six fixed life-domain roots (Career, Faith, Finance, Learning, Lifestyle, Technology), each
  with open subcategories. Required fields: url, title, category (a `root` or `root/sub` path),
  tags, priority (high|medium|low), date_added, source. Optional: note, description, added_by,
  alternatives, audience, legal_risk (required true under three specific categories that carry a
  legal-risk disclosure: learning/books-academic-papers, lifestyle/movies-torrents,
  technology/cracked-software-apks).
- **Companies** (`data/companies/<country>/<slug>.yaml`) - tech companies worth knowing about,
  surfaced on the site as a feature of Career rather than a separate top-level section. Required:
  name, website, country, industry, date_added, source. Optional: careers_url, hiring_status,
  size, rating, tags, remote_policy.

Subcategories live in an open registry (`taxonomy/categories.yaml`) rather than a fixed enum, so
they grow with the directory - but the six top-level roots themselves are fixed. Tags are
free-form. Entry counts are computed, never stored.

The `alternatives` field is declared one-way but presented both ways: if entry A lists B as an
alternative, B's page also shows A.

## Machine-readable access

- Full dataset as JSON: https://sidequest.ibtisam-iq.com/api/entries.json
- Sitemap: https://sidequest.ibtisam-iq.com/sitemap-index.xml
- Source of truth (YAML + JSON Schema): https://github.com/ibtisam-iq/sidequest

## Key pages

- https://sidequest.ibtisam-iq.com/ - overview, the six category roots, recent and top entries
- https://sidequest.ibtisam-iq.com/links - all links, filterable by category, priority, audience, tag
- https://sidequest.ibtisam-iq.com/career/companies - company directory, filterable by country,
  industry, hiring status, remote policy and size
- https://sidequest.ibtisam-iq.com/search - full-text search
